notes: The operator identifies Track 3 as the wet handling course with a 0.45-mile short configuration. This catalogue branch retains the Northern turn-in, middle S, rounded Southern return and Eastern hairpin of that short wet loop. The surrounding dry handling road and outer wet-loop extension are excluded. The centerline is manually digitized only on visible pavement in pinned public-domain 2023 USGS/USDA NAIP imagery. The independent 663.6 m measured route remains unscaled against the 698 m catalogue scalar and the approximate advertised 0.45-mile length; a 45 m catalogue allowance retains historical corner and surface-path differences as a draft limitation. No catalogue image vertices or timing positions determine these coordinates. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 663.6 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 20 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
